title: codemap.yml
description: Settings of the code map. Lists add up from the presets in extends to this file, except build.class_dirs, build.source_sets and changes.base, which replace; a scalar set later wins.

extends.description: Built-in presets, merged in order before this file.

variant.description: Build variant whose classes are read, e.g. debug, googleDebug.

snapshot.description: Where the map is written, relative to the root; {variant} and {Variant} are replaced.

class_dirs.description: Class directories of a module, relative to it; {variant} and {Variant} are replaced.

source_sets.description: Source sets read, in order; {variant} is replaced.

base.description: Refs tried in order for the merge base of `codemap changes` without --base.

dialog_bases.description: Classes whose subclasses are dialog fragments (fragments too).

preview_annotations.description: Simple names of annotations that mark a screen preview function.

preview_note.description: Shown after the title of screen previews.

layout_pattern.description: Regexp over type/name of a resource that is a screen layout.

debug_source_sets.description: Source sets whose screens are debug only.

route_bases.description: Classes whose subclasses (Kotlin objects) are routes.

child_bases.description: Classes whose subclasses are nested navigation graphs.

register.description: Class.member globs of the calls that register a destination.

open.description: Class.member globs of the calls that open a route handed to them: by name, or (typed_routes, string_routes) the route itself.

graph.description: Class.member globs of the calls that register a nested graph from its start route and its own route; opening the graph opens the start route.

not_opening.description: Member name globs of route types that read a route without opening it.

start_destination.description: The method of a graph that returns its start route.

typed_routes.description: Routes are classes: registered by a class literal (composable<T>, entry<T>), opened as an object or a constructor call handed to an open call.

string_routes.description: Routes are strings: registered by a string constant, opened by a constant or a string template; {arg} and template parts match any path segment.

hint_skip.description: Method names never shown as the step hint of nav-path.

push_markers.description: Parts of method names that mark push or deep link handling.

own.description: A step through the screen's own code.

push.description: Added for a step through push handling.

branch_slack.description: Other launcher branches shown when at most this much dearer.

path_limit.description: Shortest ways tried for one pair.

hub_min.description: Screens below a node that make it a hub.

fanout.description: Screens opened by one before a +N node.
